title: Group
description: A named set of principals that documents grant access to. access_control/groups.jsonl. No nested groups in v1: membership is always direct.

group_type.description: department = everyone in a department (GRP-finance). functional = cross-department role (GRP-support). restricted = small, audited (GRP-hr-comp, GRP-security-ir, GRP-board). service = for service accounts.

tenant_id.description: Groups are internal. Customer users get access through their tenant, not groups.

max_label.description: Highest label this group may be granted on. A grant above it is a data error the validator rejects.

examples.name: HR Compensation
examples.description: People who administer pay. Only group granted on compensation records.
